Time & Attendance Analytics Dashboard (GAC Group · Sep – Oct 2026): Turns raw monthly attendance records into executive and employee-level dashboards: absence, leave, overtime, punctuality and schedule compliance. Built with Power BI, Power Query, DAX. Knowledge Base Management System (TP · Jan 2025 – Aug 2026): Full-stack platform for articles, technical guides and FAQs, with tiered review workflows. Used by IT teams for onboarding and self-service. Built with Node.js, Express, SQL Server, JavaScript. Power BI Dashboards for Aramco and TP (TP · Jun 2024 – May 2025): KPI, attendance, survey and training dashboards on SQL Server, used daily by Aramco leadership and TP managers. Recognized by Aramco IT, May 2025, for dashboard excellence. Built with Power BI, DAX, SQL Server. IT Help Desk Website for Aramco (TP · Jan – Sep 2023): Co-developed a responsive internal portal for service listings, ticket follow-up, FAQs and support contacts, used across departments. Recognized by the Aramco IT Director, Sep 2023, for design and usability. Built with HTML, CSS, JavaScript.
